author: m_digio
content:
@feeding team I expect a certain level of responsibility from you. We have a system in place, not so that we can control people, but to verify the health and safety of the food we give to our cats. We have a schedule so that if a cat gets sick, we know who gave them the food. We have a schedule to ensure that a cat won’t go hungry.
We enjoy having a community here that people can join. This means allowing everyone to have an equal opportunity at responsibilities within our teams, instead of picking and choosing. I expect a certain maturity level from you. You are in college, you should be able to follow a schedule that you agreed to. If this is something you cannot manage, you can message me and privately resign.
I am not pointing fingers at those who need someone to cover occasionally. Things come up, it is understandable and we have a system in place to allow for feeders to sub in at spots.
